identity.name: Daikaya
notes: One Penn Quarter address contains two explicitly separate restaurant concepts: the walk-in Ramen Shop on the first floor and the reservation-based Izakaya on the second floor. Ramen is not served upstairs.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.text: No substitutions; not all requests can be fulfilled; the restaurant cannot accommodate gluten sensitivity, soy allergy, seaweed allergy, or wheat allergy requests.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.interpretation: Current exact-location operational warning. It is not converted into product negatives or a full allergen matrix.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.text: The ramen menu says substitutions are unavailable, although toppings can be removed.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.interpretation: Operational customization constraint only; removal does not establish allergen absence or cross-contact safety.

Official first-floor page identifies 705 6th St NW, Washington, DC 20001, phone 202-589-1600, and walk-in ramen service.
